page_title: OSA 3-0 ALA | Osasuna v Alaves 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' 3 - 0 A nice goal by Raul Garcia (Osasuna)! He coolly drilled a low shot deep inside the left post.
90+2' Toni Martinez (Alaves) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.
90' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
89' The substitution has been made. Jon Guridi (Alaves) has replaced Denis Suarez.
89' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
89' It's time for a substitution. Asier Osambela (Osasuna) comes on in place of Aimar Oroz.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Abel Bretones walks off the pitch to be replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
84' The attendance is 20408.
81' 2 - 0 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Antonio Sivera into the top right corner.
81' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

80' Victor Parada (Alaves) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Osasuna.
80' The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
79' Shots on target – 4:3.
77' It will be a substitution. Aitor Manas (Alaves) is ready to enter the pitch as Pablo Ibanez walks off.
76' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
75' Unbelievable miss! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
74' This is a yellow card! Carles Alena (Alaves) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
74' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

72' 1 - 0 1:0. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the left side of the net. What a finish that is! Antonio Sivera did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Aimar Oroz provided the assistance.
69' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Ruben Garcia is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
69' Substitution. Valentin Rosier makes his way off the pitch and Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
68' The referee blows his whistle as Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was too aggressive in his challenge.

65' He should have scored! Toni Martinez (Alaves) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Sergio Herrera makes an easy save.
62' Osasuna have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
61' Victor Parada (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
58' Alaves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

56' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
56' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
53' Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.

52' Antonio Sivera pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
49' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
48' The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eduardo Coudet probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Calebe (Alaves). He is replaced by Carlos Vicente.
46' Half-time substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will not participate anymore and Carles Alena is coming on.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Osasuna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
42' Osasuna try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
39' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' The possession of the ball – 51:49.
34' A lofted pass finds Victor Munoz (Osasuna) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
32' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Cesar Soto Grado who sees an offensive foul.
29' The free kick from close range, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

28' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
28' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Victor Parada (Alaves). Osasuna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

23' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
21' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
20' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes.
17' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
14' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
13' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) misses a great chance after striking the ball towards the left side of the goal and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
12' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
11' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Osasuna take a short corner kick.

8' What a wasted opportunity by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
7' A pass from Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
6' An attempted cross from Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is cleared.

4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
4' The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
2' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado is introduced as the referee for today's match.
